correctness.rationale: For all prime powers q and n,m>=1, all ordered products TiTj=0 imply U=sum images is contained in K=intersection kernels. For each chosen flag U<=K, factoring V/K -> U is a bijection, including zero ranks; independent Möbius inversion on subspaces of U and V/K forces exact image span and trivial common kernel. The rank-r map count and Gaussian flag count produce the stated double sum without stabilizer factors. The one-operator boundary matches the classical square-zero census. Independent original-equation enumeration matched 10,33,148 tuples respectively in (n,q,m)=(2,2,2),(2,3,2),(3,2,2), including every observed joint stratum. Source checks cover more prime-field and genuine F4 cases, but finite tests are not the proof.
